question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (2)** i.e. **‘thinking’.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Unluckily for Darwin, a naturalist named Wallace had been (4) _____over the same problems and had reached the same solution.
 
 
• In this sentence **‘thinking’ (सोचना) **is more appropriate rather than ‘searching’. It indicates that the thinking of both Darwin and Wallace was the same.
 
• Hence, ‘**thinking**’ is the correct answer.
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence is Darwin planned to (1) ***write***__ a book describing his (2) **__*discoveries*__**. He spent nearly twenty years (3) __***collecting ***__the matter for his book, which was to deal with every known fact concerning the problem of the species. Unluckily for Darwin, a naturalist named Wallace had been (4) __***thinking***__ over the same problems and had reached the same solution. He sent Darwin an essay which almost word for word repeated Darwin's own ideas. Yet Wallace, who was an (5) ____, had been working far away in the Malay Archipelago, whilst Darwin had not left England for several years. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__ **

 
• **Dreaming : (सपने देखना)** - Experience dreams during sleep, not suitable in this context.
 
• **Saving : (बचत)** - An economy of or reduction in money, time, or another resource, not relevant here.
 
• **Searching : (खोज)** - Try to find something by looking or otherwise seeking carefully and thoroughly, doesn’t fit the context.
